remarks: Garage Parking, Heat & Hot Water, Cooking Gas ALL included in the rental price!! No additional fees!!  Downtown Stamford Living at Its Best!  Chic, Spacious, and Steps from Everything!  This stunning, just-renovated corner unit offers approx. 1,100 sq. ft. of stylish living space, perfectly blending modern design, comfort, and unbeatable convenience.  Step inside and be wowed by brand-new flooring, elegant crown molding, and a beautifully updated kitchen featuring high-end custom cabinetry, sleek stainless steel appliances, and top-of-the-line quartz countertops. The expansive living and dining area is perfect for entertaining, and the private terrace lets you soak in breathtaking sunset views from this 8th-floor corner unit!  Both bedrooms are generously sized, and the updated bathroom adds a fresh, modern touch. New light fixtures and ceiling fans in every room keep the air flowing for year-round comfort.  Set in a secure-entry building with modernized common areas, you'll enjoy fantastic amenities, including an on-site fitness center, laundry facilities, and a beautifully landscaped courtyard-your own private retreat in the city!  And the location? Absolutely unbeatable! Just moments from the train station, I-95, and bus lines, commuting is effortless. You're steps away from Stamford's best restaurants, boutique shops, theater, and the iconic Mill River Park, a hub for festivals, concerts, and outdoor fun!
